name: kb-reflect
description: The memory 'dream': /kb-reflect consolidates past Claude Code sessions into durable curated facts. Reads session digests, dedups against existing memories (ADD/SUPERSEDE/MERGE/NOOP), and — after you approve a dry-run — writes graded, provenance-linked facts via `kb remember`. The distiller is the live agent (same model, same tokens); the daemon stays model-free. Append-only, human-gated, recall untouched (#10).
